---
name: simplify-doc
description: Polishes any given documentation file to be fluent, concise, and token-efficient. Use when a doc has grown verbose, redundant, or unclear.
---

The user will provide a doc file to polish. Rewrite it to be concise and fluent:

1. Read and fully understand the file's purpose, audience, and content.
2. Remove redundancy: merge overlapping statements into single, direct sentences.
3. Improve fluency: fix awkward phrasing, passive voice, and unnecessary filler words.
4. Preserve all distinct rules and intent — do not silently drop information.
5. Retain the existing heading structure; remove a section only if it is empty after consolidation.
6. Overwrite the file with the simplified result.
